problem_text:
A logistics coordinator needs to assign packages to identical delivery trucks. Packages:
* Package Alpha: volume 43 cubic feet
* Package Beta: volume 35 cubic feet
* Package Gamma: volume 67 cubic feet
* Package Delta: volume 39 cubic feet
* Package Epsilon: volume 45 cubic feet
* Package Zeta: volume 63 cubic feet
* Package Eta: volume 43 cubic feet
* Package Theta: volume 58 cubic feet
* Package Iota: volume 50 cubic feet
* Package Kappa: volume 30 cubic feet
* Package Lambda: volume 46 cubic feet
* Package Mu: volume 56 cubic feet
* Package Nu: volume 67 cubic feet
* Package Xi: volume 63 cubic feet
* Package Omicron: volume 65 cubic feet
* Package Pi: volume 38 cubic feet
* Package Rho: volume 51 cubic feet
* Package Sigma: volume 66 cubic feet
* Package Tau: volume 64 cubic feet
* Package Upsilon: volume 54 cubic feet
* Package Phi: volume 42 cubic feet
* Package Chi: volume 49 cubic feet
* Package Psi: volume 36 cubic feet
* Package Omega: volume 58 cubic feet
* Package Ares: volume 70 cubic feet
* Package Zeus: volume 47 cubic feet
* Package Hera: volume 45 cubic feet

Each truck can carry up to 100 cubic feet of cargo. Assign all packages using the fewest trucks possible. Every package must be loaded onto exactly one truck, and the total volume in any truck cannot exceed its capacity.
